text:
Anna: Quick question  candidate verbally accepted but asked for a $12k sign-on. Role L4 band cap is $8k. Manager wants them to start Monday to hit a customer demo. Can we expedite an exception?

Diego: Background: this is a cross-functional short-term pilot. Losing this start date delays the demo and could risk a milestone payment. Manager requests $12k one-time sign-on and is willing to have 100% paid on first paycheck.

Jules (Recruiter): Offer sent at 08:45 and candidate signed. They prefer to start 2025-05-05. If comp stays at $8k they may delay start by 2 weeks.

Anna: Two asks: 1) approval to exceed band by $4k; 2) confirm payroll can pay full sign-on on first paycheck if needed.

Nina: Payroll can do 100% on first paycheck but flagged audit rule that sign-ons >$10k need Comp Committee + Finance approval. Also we need hiring manager attestation and GL coding before processing.

Diego: Manager justification: "Urgent demo coverage; candidate has product knowledge; otherwise demo delayed and partner contract clause triggered."

Anna: I'll fill the comp-exception form: https://redwood.intra/comp-exceptions and attach the signed offer.

Jules (Recruiter): Comp details pasted:
```
Base: $142,000
Level: L4
Band cap sign-on: $8,000
Requested sign-on: $12,000
Payment: 100% first paycheck
Justification: Critical demo; must start 5/5 to meet partner milestone
```

Payroll Bot: Routing reminder: >$10k exceptions route to Comp Committee + Finance. Include manager sign-off and DocuSign attachment.

Anna: Form submitted (ticket HR-902). Routing to @comp-committee and @finance.

Nina: I'll prepare GL string and confirm withholding. Tax treatment normal; full tranche taxed in period paid.

Comp Committee Chair: Noted. Will triage now; aiming for same-day decision. Please add manager approval and attach any customer-side notes.

Diego: Manager approval posted in form. Also attaching the partner email referencing milestone.

Jules (Recruiter): Candidate said they'd sign an addendum if we confirm by EOD.

Anna: Marking request as time-sensitive. Requesting "one-off" flag in approval to avoid broader policy change.

Comp Committee Chair: Approve as one-off. Finance to confirm budget reallocation to team 1330 (Pilot).

Nina: Finance confirmed budget move and GL 560-1330-PAID. Payroll will process full sign-on on next run for start date.

Jules (Recruiter): Candidate notified, will sign addendum via DocuSign now.

Anna: Thanks everyone. I'll post the final status and close HR-902 once DocuSign lands. :thumbsup:
